adversary.role: uses the page like a demanding customer: desktop and phone viewport, odd inputs, slow clicks

ui.complaint_evidence: screenshot of the same screen the complaint describes

gates.text: The requested change is visible on the real page
Nothing overflows, overlaps or is cut off
Every interactive element responds
No console errors on load

adversary.role: steps through the output frame by frame or page by page and lists every artifact, glitch and mismatch with the brief

render.complaint_evidence: the frame or crop where the complaint was seen

gates.text: The output matches the brief in the frames that matter
No visible glitches: warped shapes, flicker, text errors, cut-off edges
gates.evidence: frame crops at the start, middle and end

gates.text: Length, size and format are what was asked

tests: Extract frames at the start, middle and end

adversary.role: reads as the intended reader and marks every sentence they would not understand or trust

doc.complaint_evidence: the rendered page or text where the complaint was seen

gates.text: Every claim in the document is backed by a source or a number you can find
The rendered output has no broken layout, empty pages or cut tables
Answers the question the reader came with in the first paragraph

adversary.role: plays the person who will receive it and says what they would do after reading

message.complaint_evidence: the exact sentence that caused the complaint, before and after

gates.text: The recipient can act on it without asking a question back
Facts in the text match the source they came from
Tone fits the relationship

tests: Check each fact against its source

adversary.role: reads the diff, runs it on edge inputs, looks for the case that breaks

code.complaint_evidence: the failing command or input re-run, output captured

params.runtime: the real entry point (CLI, hook stdin, server)

gates.text: Does what was asked end to end on the real entry point
Tests exist for the new behaviour and pass
Edge cases: empty input, missing file, bad JSON, non-ASCII text, Windows paths
Fails safe: an error never loses data or blocks the user

tests: Pipe sample input into the entry point

adversary.role: recounts rows, samples records and looks for duplicates, gaps and silent truncation

data.complaint_evidence: query or count that shows the problem before and after

gates.text: Row counts match between source and destination
A random sample of records matches field by field
Rerunning the load changes nothing

adversary.role: assumes the deploy changed something it should not have and reads the environment back

deploy.complaint_evidence: read-back from the target environment, not from the deploy tool

gates.text: The change is live in the target environment
The previous behaviour that must not change still works
Rollback path is stated and was checked to exist

adversary.role: proposes two other causes and asks what observation separates them from yours

diagnosis.complaint_evidence: the observation that the proposed cause explains

gates.text: The cause was reproduced or its absence made the symptom vanish
At least two alternative causes were ruled out with an observation each

tests: Remove the suspected cause and observe

adversary.role: the most demanding person who will use the result, assuming it is broken

other.complaint_evidence: whatever the person looked at when they said it was wrong

gates.text: Does what was asked, as the person would check it
Nothing else that worked before is now broken
